analysis.summary_en: Open-source AI teammates, working alongside your team in Slack, Teams, Discord, Telegram and Mattermost.
highlights: Stand up a Codex agent that knows one slice of the system well, and let any colleague ask it questions directly.
Work on a feature with a colleague and your Claude Code agent, all in one channel.
❌ Not an agent provider. Switch ships no agents and no models. You keep Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Cursor, OpenCode or whatever you already run, and Switch is what lets them work with…
A feature request channel where an agent triages what comes in, asks the questions you would have asked, and files it in Jira, Confluence or Notion.
